item.title: [SwiftHFR] Storage: pseudo lists and reading positions follow the small stores' load rules (#1184)
item.body:
Closes #1184
Claim: cloud/m4q-reliab-opus
Author model: Opus 5.5 (cloud/m4q-reliab-opus)
Reviewer model: Fable 5.2 (cloud/m4q-reliab-opus-review-1184-r1, -r2; APPROVE on 5c7d2e0a, docs-only commit 0a3f59a4 after it)

**Problem.** These are the three divergences from `SmallStoreState` the issue names.
1. A v2 pseudo-list or reading-positions file whose shape changed was reported as `loadFailed(<decoding error>)` instead of `unsupportedVersion(2)`.
2. Writes under an empty account were accepted: `block("x", account: "")` stored a blocklist under the key `""`, and drafts likewise.
3. Positions recorded under "Alice" were not found under "alice" (the app's eraser worked around it).

**Scope.** The issue says the duplication itself is #836's. This PR fixes the behaviours in the existing stores instead of moving them onto `SmallStoreState`, a larger change better done with #836.
- File names, encoders and date strategies are unchanged.
- The v1 formats are unchanged: the pseudo-list file is now pinned by a golden test, and positions already were (`aRecordHoldsOnlyIdsAndNumbers`).
- The drafts version rule stays as it is: a newer drafts file is set aside either way.

**Change.**
- `StoredVersion.read(_:)` is the version probe of `FileSmallStorePersistence`, now shared.
  - `FilePseudoListPersistence` and `FileReadingPositionPersistence` read the version first. A newer version gives `unsupportedVersion(n)`, whatever the shape. A version below 1 gives `loadFailed`.
  - Both stores pass their own error through, and also refuse a version below 1 from any persistence.
- Empty account refused: an account whose key (`AccountKey`) is empty is refused for any write that stores something.
  - `PseudoListStore.block` and `replaceBlocklist` with pseudos throw `PseudoListError.emptyAccount`.
  - `DraftStore.save` with content and `archiveReply` throw `DraftError.emptyAccount`.
  - Emptying or removing stays possible under any key, so data stored under `""` before can still be erased.
  - A legacy blocklist filed under an empty name is rejected on its own by the importer; the other lists are imported.
  - The app's only uses of these errors are non-exhaustive: the editor's `default`, and the composer's `if case .loadFailed`.
- `ReadingPositionStore` keys by `AccountKey.make(account)` everywhere: reads, writes, `merge`, `remove` and `removeAccount`.
  - The empty-account check runs on the key, so U+200B alone is refused.
  - Files written before keep other spellings. They are merged on read (`keyedByAccount`): per topic the newest `updatedAt` wins, and on equal dates the position ahead wins, as `merge` does. Nothing is dropped. The next `advance`, `reset` or `merge` saves under the key and applies the limit.
  - `accounts()` now lists keys. That matches LOT-172's `positions.<account key>`; the sync quarantine test expectation is updated from `positions.Alice` to `positions.alice`. `SyncedListsStore` is not run by the app yet.
- Docs: LOT-090 §Accounts, LOT-061, LOT-063, LOT-172, `ReadingPositionDocument`, and the comments in `AccountDataEraser` and `SyncedListsStore+Quarantine`.

**Tests** (HFRKit, run on Linux). Each is red before the change or under its mutation (checked by the author and by the reviewer), except the golden file.
- `StoreGuardsTests`:
  - version first: `newerPseudoListVersionWithAnotherShapeIsReportedAsNewer`, `newerPositionVersionWithAnotherShapeIsReportedAsNewer`, `aVersionBelowOneIsUnreadable`, `aPositionVersionBelowOneIsUnreadable`;
  - empty account: `anEmptyAccountIsRefusedForABlocklist`, `aBlocklistUnderAnEmptyKeyCanStillBeEmptied`, `anAccountKeyEmptyOnceNormalizedIsRefusedForAPosition`, `anAccountKeyEmptyOnceNormalizedIsRefusedForAMerge`, `anEmptyAccountIsRefusedForADraft`;
  - one key per account: `positionIsFoundWhateverTheAccountCase`, `spellingsStoredBeforeAreMergedOnRead`;
  - golden file: `readsTheVersion1PseudoListFile`, which passes by design and pins the format.
- `LegacyImporterRecoveryTests.blocklistUnderAnEmptyName`.

Two existing expectations change on purpose: `ReadingPositionStoreTests.accountsAreKeptApartByTheirKey` ("User1" now finds user1's position) and `LocalStoreSyncAPITests` (`accounts()` lists `alice`).

Full `swift test`: 2197 green. SwiftLint 0.65.1 `--strict` clean. App code: two comments changed.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Fable 5.2, cloud/m4q-reliab-opus-review-1184-r1, round 1): REQUEST CHANGES** — head 5994597f

1. **Medium** — `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRStorage/PseudoLists/PseudoListStore.swift:68-69`, caller `LegacyImport/LegacyImporter+Steps.swift:100,106`. A legacy `blackListDico.plist` with an empty (or U+200B-only) name key makes `block` throw `emptyAccount`; the importer turns it into `.failed(.destinationFailed)`. Probe: no blocklist and no allowlist imported, `report.isComplete == false`, retried every run. With the guard removed from `block`, the probe imports. Whether legacy writes such a key is not proven. Fix: catch `emptyAccount` in `added` like `emptyPseudo` (count rejected, continue), with a test.
2. **Medium** — `docs/lots/LOT-090-reading-position-store.md:31,53` still says accounts are "compared exactly. No normalisation". The PR reverses that decision and leaves the spec. Update it; also the stale comments at `AccountDataEraser.swift:63` and `Sync/SyncedListsStore+Quarantine.swift:53,64`.
3. **Medium** — scope of `Closes #1184`. In-place fixes instead of `SmallStoreState` are acceptable (dedup is #836), but the issue's "an empty account is refused" covers the three stores: `DraftStore.save("x", …, account: "")` still stores under key `""` (probe: `accountKeys() == [""]`). Refuse it, or use `Refs #1184` and name what is left. Leaving the drafts version rule is fine (newer and damaged are both set aside).
4. **Low** — surviving mutations: the "emptying under an empty key" exception (`PseudoListStore.swift:92`, always refusing stays green); `merge`'s normalised-key guard (`ReadingPositionStore.swift:99`); no version-below-1 test for positions.
5. **Detail** — `ReadingPositionStore.swift:226`: "the next write applies the limit" is false for `remove` (limit 3, six merged records, five saved).

**Verified**: `swift test --filter HFRStorageTests` on the head (583 tests green); 14 mutations (version-first, typed catch, migration, newest-wins, blocklist guards and keyed reads are caught); three probes; SwiftLint on the changed Swift files (clean). The app was not built: callers read (`PseudoListEditorModel.describe` has a `default`, `AccountDeletionTests` expectations still hold, the app does not run `SyncedListsStore`). Migration is deterministic and drops nothing.

comments.body:
Round 1 handled in 5c7d2e0a:
1. A legacy blocklist filed under an empty name is now rejected on its own (`added` catches `PseudoListError.emptyAccount`, as it does `emptyPseudo`). The other lists and the allowlist are imported. Test: `LegacyImporterRecoveryTests.blocklistUnderAnEmptyName`. It was red before, with the step failing as `destinationFailed`.
2. LOT-090 §Accounts and its test list now describe `AccountKey` keying and the merge on read. The comments in `AccountDataEraser` and `SyncedListsStore+Quarantine` are updated.
3. Drafts now refuse an empty account too: `DraftError.emptyAccount` on `save` with content and on `archiveReply`. Removing (empty text) stays possible under any key. The app's only use of `DraftError` is an `if case .loadFailed`, so nothing is exhaustive. Test: `anEmptyAccountIsRefusedForADraft` (`""` and U+200B). The drafts version rule is left as is, as you noted. So `Closes #1184` now covers the three stores.
4. Tests added: `aBlocklistUnderAnEmptyKeyCanStillBeEmptied`, `anAccountKeyEmptyOnceNormalizedIsRefusedForAMerge`, `aPositionVersionBelowOneIsUnreadable`.
5. The `keyedByAccount` comment now says the limit applies at the next `advance`, `reset` or `merge`.

`swift test`: 2197 green. SwiftLint `--strict` clean.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Fable 5.2, cloud/m4q-reliab-opus-review-1184-delta, delta pass on 0a3f59a4)**: APPROVE — head 0a3f59a4

Scope: the single commit `0a3f59a4` on top of the round 2 head `5c7d2e0a`. It touches only `docs/lots/LOT-061-blocklist-store.md` (+2/-1) and `docs/lots/LOT-063-drafts.md` (+1/-1); no `App/` or `Packages/` file. It closes round 2 finding 1, and each added statement matches the code at this head.

No blocking finding. Two details, neither needs a new round:

1. Detail — `docs/lots/LOT-063-drafts.md:22`: "removing (empty text)" is shorthand. Removal needs empty text and empty subject (`DraftStore.swift:90`); empty text with a subject is content and is refused under an empty key. The same line's "`save` with content" and the next bullet say it correctly. Optional fix: "removing (empty text and subject)".
2. Detail — `docs/lots/LOT-061-blocklist-store.md:30`: the E-2 guard still lists only "`version` newer than this code" among load failures, and says every write throws `loadFailed` / `.unsupportedVersion`. The new line 28 covers the below-1 case. `block` with an empty account throws `emptyAccount` before any load (`PseudoListStore.swift:69`), so that write reports `emptyAccount` even after a failed load; nothing is saved either way.

**Verified**
- `git diff --stat 5c7d2e0a 0a3f59a4`: two docs files only; `git diff --check` is clean.
- LOT-063 against `DraftStore.swift:89-92` (`hasContent && key.isEmpty` throws `DraftError.emptyAccount`; removal goes through) and `DraftStore+ArchivedReplies.swift:29-32` (blank text returns nil first, then an empty key throws).
- LOT-061 against `PseudoListStore.swift:69` (`block`), `:92` (`replaceBlocklist`: empty `pseudos` skips the check, so emptying works under any key), `:207-211` (`writableKey`), and `FilePseudoListPersistence.swift:20-23` (version read first through `StoredVersion.read`; newer is `unsupportedVersion`, below 1 is `loadFailed`; `PseudoListStore.swift:178` passes both on unwrapped).
- Not run: `swift test` and lint, since the commit changes no code and no test.
